findings.title: search_files symlink traversal
findings.notes: search_files follows symlinks outside jupyter_root_dir. Still unfixed on main. PR #26 open.

findings.title: PR review workflow vulnerable to prompt injection via diff content
findings.notes: LLM prompt embeds PR diff without injection-resistant framing; unvalidated output posted as PR comment. Fix: untrusted-content delimiters, system instruction hardening, comment disclaimer.

findings.title: list_files enumerates host files through workspace symlinks
findings.notes: list_files uses Path.glob() which follows symlinks without resolving matches against workspace root. Same class as #13 (search_files) but in a different function not covered by PR #26. Fix: resolve each glob match and reject outside workspace. PR #31 was closed without merging by maintainer.

no_new_findings_reason: Pass B (2026-07-04): Reviewed UPSTREAM tip plmbr/notebook-intelligence@d9f76a5 (v5.2.1). The upstream app code (notebook_intelligence/, src/) is byte-identical to the last-reviewed fork commit d090801 (git diff empty; fork only layers pr-review automation on top), so this is the same code state already covered by the 16-surface review. No new attack surface. Confirmed open symlink-traversal findings still present and unfixed: search_files (#13, glob at built_in_toolsets.py:327) and list_files (#30, glob at :440/:443) — safe_jupyter_path/_get_safe_path validates only the base directory, not each glob match, so an in-workspace symlink is followed. PR #26 (search_files) open; PR #31 (list_files) closed without merge by maintainer. Also reviewed the recent permission-mode selector w/ gated bypass (#377, claude.py resolve_permission_mode): fails closed — unknown modes collapse to default and bypass requires both allow_bypass and managed-settings consent, and crosses no trust boundary under NBI's stated per-user security model. No new medium+ findings; nothing filed.
